content:
Anya: FYI ran a quick prefetch/proxy speculative decode run on llama3-12b q4_0. Summary:
- p50 latency: -18%
- p95 latency: -12%
- throughput (tokens/s): x1.8
- summarization ROUGE-L: -0.9
- fact-F1 (QA check): -2.1

Mike: nice. what's the config + eval set?

Anya: config pasted:
```
speculative:
  prefetch_tokens: 2
  lookahead: 64
  fallback_threshold: 0.35
runtime:
  quant: q4_0
  kv_cache: lazy
``` 
Eval set: 1k internal summaries + 500 closed-book QA checks. Observed failure mode: long enumerated prefixes -> model jumps to short completion and hallucinate.

Priya: can you try fallback_threshold=0.2 and prefetch_tokens=1? Also test with q8_0 and disabled lazy kv.

Sam: queued smoke on dedicated pool (dc-west). I'll post logs. ETA ~20m.

EvalBot: run 1723456790 completed. delta vs baseline: p95 -10%, ROUGE-L -0.5, fact-F1 -1.2. detailed artifacts: https://internal.redwood/evals/1723456790

Mike: sounds borderline. If q8_0 recovers quality without too much latency loss, ok. If not, we should add an input classifier to disable prefetch for list-like prefixes.

Anya: agreed. next steps: (1) Sam run q8_0 with fallback=0.2, (2) Priya add classifier probe on 500 examples, (3) I'll run full 10k eval overnight. ping me with artifacts.

Priya: noted. I'll prototype a simple regex-based detector first.

Sam: starting q8_0 run now. will share logs when done. :hourglass:

Anya: thanks all. keeping this thread for quick sync. :white_check_mark:
